pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S. B. REGISTRY. 6782
S. 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date June 15, 1935.
Subject Arrival of M.F. Jukoff, Soviet Citizen.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [签名]
Mihail F. JUKOFF, 27, Soviet citizen, reported to be
an employee of the Moscow Narodny Bank, arrived in Shanghai
from Moscow via Vladivostock on June 12, 1935, in the s.s. "SEVER".
He holds passport No. 107752-1118 issued on May 8, 1935, at
Moscow.
According to his own statement he will be attached
to the local branch of the Moscow Narodny Bank and intends to
remain in this city for about two years.
Jukoff is accompanied by his wife, Mrs. Vera S.
Jukoff, 27 years of age.
Their address in Shanghai has not yet been located.
G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.
D. C. (Special Branch).
[签名]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号：S. B. 登记处 6782
S. 2，特别科。
报告
日期：1935年6月15日。
事由：苏联公民 M.F. Jukoff 抵沪。
呈报人：特别科侦探长 Prokofiev。转呈人：[签名]
Mihail F. JUKOFF，27岁，苏联公民，据称为莫斯科国民银行（Moscow Narodny Bank）职员，于1935年6月12日乘“SEVER”号轮船经符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）从莫斯科抵达上海。
他持有1935年5月8日在莫斯科签发的第107752-1118号护照。
据其自述，他将任职于莫斯科国民银行本地分行，并计划在本市停留约两年。
Jukoff 由其妻子 Vera S. Jukoff 夫人陪同，年龄27岁。
其在上海的住址尚未查明。
G. Prokofiev
特别科侦探长
副督察长（特别科）。
[签名]
